verdict.rationale: File converters can reasonably be asked how they handle untrusted input, so the axis applies, but no evidence item covers macro or script neutralisation, content-only parsing, or execution isolation. The 'sandbox.zamzar.com' endpoint is a test environment for API calls, not sandboxed isolation of file contents, so it earns no credit. File deletion after conversion is a privacy control, not safe handling of active content.

support.subject: As an ops lead, the converter treats untrusted input safely: scripts and macros are read as content, never executed
